subject: CS478
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 2 Arabic videos. Coverage in English is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is limited; while good videos were found for the rasterization pipeline and GPU parallelism, no suitable, university-level Arabic content was found for the programmable pipeline, MVP matrices (due to confusion with the MVC software pattern), or GLSL shader programming (due to a flood of irrelevant Minecraft mod videos).

coverage.note: Other candidates failed the view count gate.
The only candidate was about the fixed-function pipeline, failing the relevance gate.
All candidates were about the 'Model-View-Controller' software pattern, not 'Model-View-Projection' matrices, failing the relevance gate.
All viable candidates were about installing Minecraft shader mods, not programming in GLSL, failing the relevance gate.

videos.title: How Real Time Computer Graphics and Rasterization work
videos.filter_reason: A perfectly focused and well-animated explanation of how rasterization works within the real-time graphics pipeline, ideal for students.

videos.title: How do Graphics Cards Work?  Exploring GPU Architecture
videos.filter_reason: An exceptionally clear, high-level explanation of GPU architecture and massive parallelism that has reached millions, making it a perfect starting point.

videos.title: [Episode 4] [Theory] The Programmable Graphics Pipeline (Interview Question) - Modern OpenGL
videos.topic_ar: مراحل خط أنابيب الرسومات القابلة للبرمجة
videos.filter_reason: A dedicated theory lesson from a trusted educator that directly addresses the programmable pipeline, its stages, and data flow.

videos.title: The Math behind (most) 3D games - Perspective Projection
videos.filter_reason: This video masterfully demystifies the mathematics behind the projection matrix, directly addressing the most daunting part of the MVP concept for students.

videos.title: An introduction to Shader Art Coding
videos.filter_reason: A hugely popular and visually inspiring introduction to shader coding that makes an abstract and difficult topic feel approachable and creative.

videos.title: Lecture 1 Computer Graphics Introduction
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive university lecture in Arabic that explicitly covers the graphics pipeline, rasterization, and related concepts.

videos.title: هل ستنهي وحدة معالجة الموتر الجديدة من جوجل عصر وحدات معالجة الرسومات بهدوء؟
videos.filter_reason: This video explains GPU parallelism in a modern, engaging context by comparing it to TPUs for AI, making the concept highly relevant.
